Atlas Gameplay Tags

One declaration owner per name. Read contracts and extension rules before creating mod children. Unreviewed entries are not promised public APIs.

External mod declarations

owner
AtlasModdingSystem runtime/authoring manifest validator
product_setting
AtlasModdingDeveloperSettings.ModTagExtensionRoots
approved_roots
['Damage.Type', 'GameplayCue', 'Gameplay.Message', 'Inventory.ContextAction', 'State', 'Status', 'Inventory.Item.Category', 'Inventory.Item.Gameplay', 'Inventory.Item.Stat', 'Inventory.Equipment', 'Inventory.Crafting.Station', 'Equipment.Action', 'Interaction.Operation', 'Interaction.Value', 'Resource.Type', 'Resource.Rarity', 'Resource.Meta', 'Statistics', 'Quest.Event', 'Perk.Pool', 'Floor.Flow.Content.Mod', 'World.Actor.Slot', 'Session.Setting']
namespace
<approved semantic parent or descendant>.Mod.<ContentId segments>.<Name>
identity
ContentId is case-insensitive. Lowercase each segment, then capitalize its first letter; retain hyphens/underscores. Each segment must start with a letter. author.pack maps to Mod.Author.Pack.
files
Direct Config/Tags/<PluginName>_<Topic>.ini files; at most 32, 256 KiB each and 1 MiB total.
syntax
Only [/Script/GameplayTags.GameplayTagsList], GameplayTagList=(Tag="...",DevComment="...") and GameplayTagRedirects=(OldTagName="...",NewTagName="..."); no + prefix: these are standalone source lists, not config hierarchy array overrides. Use Unreal serialized field order. No arbitrary settings or array removals.
redirects
Both names belong to the same ContentId under approved roots. Target is declared by the mod; old name is no longer declared. No chains, cycles, duplicate or self redirects.
use_existing
Referencing an existing tag does not require permission to redeclare it. Do not copy base definitions into your mod.
delivery
CookContentMod runs native manifest validation before cook. Receipt v2 hashes ContentId and all delivered tag files. Runtime revalidates ownership and hashes before registration; arbitrary Config files are rejected.
lifetime
Dictionary entries may stay resident after deactivation. Release effect/count/listener/content handles separately; resident name is never an activation test.
compatibility
Receipt v1 without loose Config remains supported. New tag declarations require v2.

Gameplay.Message

Matching

Authority

Resource.Type

Role
Resource classification and generation policy
Matching
World resource queries use child MatchesTag(parent). Generation adjustments also inspect type ancestry; exact identity maps remain exact.
Payload
FGameplayTag on UAtlasResourceDefinition; Resource.Meta uses FGameplayTagContainer.
Authority
Tags describe selection. Authority and inventory changes are enforced by the resource and inventory owners.
Lifetime
Definition data, loaded and selected through Asset Manager; runtime generation remains server owned.
Extension
Declare below Resource.Type.Mod.<CanonicalContentId>.<Name>. Declare in the owning Game Feature; a tag does not register a resource definition.
Declaration
